Company description: KHC (Generated via gemini-3.1-flash-lite)

The Kraft Heinz Company (KHC) is one of the world’s largest food and beverage corporations, operating a diverse portfolio of iconic brands across categories including condiments, sauces, cheese, dairy, meals, meats, and refreshment beverages. Headquartered in Chicago and Pittsburgh, the company maintains a significant global presence, distributing products in over 190 countries. Its portfolio includes household names such as Kraft, Heinz, Oscar Mayer, Philadelphia, Velveeta, and Jell-O.

The company was formed through the 2015 merger of Kraft Foods Group and H.J. Heinz Company, a transaction orchestrated by 3G Capital and Berkshire Hathaway. This strategic combination united two historic entities; H.J. Heinz was founded in 1869, while the Kraft business traces its origins to James L. Kraft’s cheese distribution enterprise established in 1903. Today, Kraft Heinz focuses on driving sustainable growth through innovation, brand investment, and operational efficiency, aiming to meet evolving consumer preferences while maintaining its legacy as a cornerstone of the global food industry.
